root_text:
𝗜𝘀 𝗛𝗠𝗣𝗩 𝘀𝗶𝗺𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗿 𝘁𝗼 𝗖𝗢𝗩𝗜𝗗-𝟭𝟵 𝗩𝗜𝗥𝗨𝗦?
Yes. Coronavirus disease or COVID-19 is an infectious disease which is caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus. The HMPV virus and the SARS-CoV-2 virus are similar in some ways. https://t.co/aTvK3I4uly

nodes.author: gvmmanoj
nodes.text:
𝗜𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗲 𝗔 𝗩𝗔𝗖𝗖𝗜𝗡𝗘 𝘁𝗼 𝗽𝗿𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗛𝗠𝗣𝗩 𝗦𝗣𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗗?
No. There is currently no vaccine, and antiviral treatment is not recommended.But following steps recommended to prevent.
🟣wash hands and use hand sanitizer 
🟣Avoid touching eyes,nose mouth. https://t.co/mHZftAz4m3

nodes.author: gvmmanoj
nodes.text:
🟣Avoid close contact with people who are sick.
🟣Always use mask who have cold-like symptoms.
🟣Avoid sharing cups and eating utensils with others. https://t.co/DbDhjhjNH4

nodes.author: gvmmanoj
nodes.text:
𝗦𝗵𝗼𝘂𝗹𝗱 𝗶𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗮 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗿𝗶𝗲𝗱 𝗮𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁 𝗛𝗠𝗣𝗩 𝘃𝗶𝗿𝘂𝘀?
Dr Atul Goel, Director-General of Health Services, reassured the public that there is nothing to be alarmed about the present situation. He urged people to take general precautions. https://t.co/Bfd71oF1kp
